resource_range_method: Exact range of all three fresh ON processes; descriptive, not a confidence interval

definitions.role: Only weak-ON measured. The original weak reader calls this role before; it is not the EA5 main before baseline. OFF/direct results are absent from this collection.
definitions.latency: Scheduled arrival to successful completion, including queue/IPC. Scenario p50/p95/p99 and means are original per-process values.
definitions.rates: Each scenario contributes to the fixed mix over the whole process observation window. Configured20s differs from the actual guarded window; exact denominators are retained.
definitions.a21_noise: Original five arrival-mean bands are max(1000ns, range of three fresh ON process means), relative noise zero.
definitions.resource_noise: Eleven exact max-minus-min vectors: five scenario p99 and CPU/RSS/managed allocation per profile. Descriptive ranges, not confidence intervals or new mean bands.
definitions.resources: CPU/RSS/GC belong to whole mixed processes. CPU percent is of one core. RSS is sampled. Allocation uses a partial sampled GC.GetTotalAllocatedBytes(false) bracket, not exact bytes/call.
definitions.protocol_bytes: Payload and protobuf encoded bytes/messages stay separate; encoded bytes exclude the gRPC envelope, HTTP/2 framing and TLS.
definitions.drain: Original completed result/retirement reports, disposed owners and post-idle gauges; warmup/recovery/idle do not enter latency samples.
definitions.unavailable: No native allocation/FFI/copy counts or exact active HTTP/2 stream count is inferred; maximum_in_progress_client_calls is client lifecycle overlap.

public_scope: Numerical samples, ranges and necessary identities only; internal paths, commands and file inventories are excluded.
